thread:
sophia: heads-up — deploy-bot queued a Dedicated runtime kernel micro-patch + temporary runtime pin tonight 23:00 UTC. planned window 90m. posting for comms/rollback alignment.

deploy-bot: [scheduled change] service=dedicated-runtime | window=2026-03-20T23:00:00Z..2026-03-21T00:30:00Z | actions=[kernel-micro-patch, runtime-version-pin] | risk=medium | auto-rollback=enabled

jamie: quick Q — is the pin going to lock customer-visible runtime versions? need to know for reserved tenants.

maria: pin is temporary for 72h to observe perf and regressions. customers retain control of model weights; runtime binary pinned to previous known-good build for the period. if everything looks stable we'll schedule a managed upgrade with 7d notice.

eli: draft statuspage snippet (short):
"We will perform a kernel micro-patch on Dedicated GPU runtime starting 23:00 UTC. This will occur as rolling restarts over ~90 minutes. API traffic will continue; you may see short tail-latency spikes. We will pin runtime versions for 72 hours to validate performance. If we detect material regressions we will rollback and notify affected customers."

sophia: add a sentence about quantized models: small output distribution shifts possible. include support contact and a link to the rollback runbook.

eli: updated statuspage snippet:
"Maintenance: Dedicated runtime kernel patch — rolling restarts starting 23:00 UTC (90m window). Traffic will remain served; intermittent latency spikes may occur. Runtime versions will be temporarily pinned for 72 hours to monitor metrics. Customers using quantized models may observe minor score drift during the pin period. If we detect regressions we will rollback and follow up. For urgent issues contact support@redwood.ai and see: https://go.redwood/runbooks/runtime-rollback"

jamie: flag for accounts — can we add a callout that account teams will reach out to enterprise customers with strict SLOs? want them prepped.

maria: yes — I'll ping account owners in ~5m. also prepping an email template for impacted tenants.

maria: email template (support can send):
``
Subject: Planned maintenance: Dedicated runtime patch (23:00 UTC)
Hi <Customer>,
We will perform a maintenance window on <date> at 23:00 UTC to apply a kernel micro-patch and temporarily pin the runtime (72 hours) to validate performance. Expected impact: rolling restarts and short, infrequent latency spikes. No action required. If you rely on strict latency/accuracy SLOs we'll contact you directly. If you see regressions we will rollback and follow up.
If you need immediate help: support@redwood.ai
— Platform Ops
```

eli: small note — statuspage tag should be "maintenance" not "incident" to avoid pager noise.

sophia: agree. and set auto-rollback threshold conservative: error_rate>2% for 3m or p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m -> trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: auto-rollback thresholds updated: error_rate>2% over 3m; p95>2x baseline over 5m.

jamie: I'll run the post-change smoke/sanity pass 10m after completion and post numbers here. will check error rate, p50/p95, and a small eval against our canary prompt set.

maria: support, please stand by with the email template and a churn of canned responses for customers reporting regressions.

support: ready. have template + escalation matrix. will triage any customer tickets with priority "maintenance" and route to mari.

eli: final checklist before we post: 1) statuspage copy (me) 2) email to enterprise (maria) 3) deploy-bot thresholds set (sophia) 4) perf sweep owner (jamie) 5) support ready (support). anything else?

sophia: that's it. posting statuspage 20m before window.

deploy-bot: [change started] rolling restarts initiated

jamie: post-change smoke @23:40 UTC — p50 ~baseline, p95 +8% (within tolerance), error rate 0.6%. small drift on one quant model in canary eval (delta -0.4 BLEU-equivalent) — filing follow-up with model team.

eli: statuspage follow-up posted: "Maintenance complete. No material customer-impact detected; runtime pin will remain for 72h while we monitor. We will notify if any changes or rollbacks occur." :thumbsup:

maria: accounts notified. closing channel for now unless we see alerts. thanks all. :tada:
